title: bendable faux bamboo
text: bendable faux bamboo. I purchased these to augment a faux flower bouquet I have.  They are very skinny - more skinny than I was expecting, but they look ok.  They are very green - dark green.  They come folded in half which originally concerned me, however, they very easy bend to pretty much any look you'd like, so the fold didn't make any difference.  They are just short of 2' long - which if you curl - means they are will be quite a bit shorter (obviously - right?).  I am going to look for some slightly wider, longer options - maybe a little less green.
